citations.finding: A Sanders press release opposes a health care bill as opposed by major health care organizations and the American people, but the snippet does not identify the bill as the ACA or show Sanders opposing Obamacare itself.
citations.quote: “This bill is opposed by virtually every major health care organization in this country. It is opposed overwhelmingly by the American people.
